subject_matter.hypothesis: The contract sets out the subject matter of the processing.

duration.hypothesis: The contract sets out the duration of the processing.

nature_purpose.hypothesis: The contract sets out the nature and purpose of the processing.

data_categories.hypothesis: The contract sets out the types of personal data.

data_subject_categories.hypothesis: The contract sets out the categories of data subjects.

controller_obligations_rights.hypothesis: The contract sets out the controller's obligations and rights.

art28_3_a_instructions.hypothesis: The processor processes personal data only on documented instructions from the controller.

art28_3_b_confidentiality.hypothesis: Persons authorised to process personal data are committed to confidentiality.

art28_3_c_security.hypothesis: The processor implements appropriate technical and organisational security measures.

art28_3_d_subprocessors.hypothesis: The processor does not engage another processor without controller authorisation.

art28_3_e_dsr_assistance.hypothesis: The processor assists the controller in responding to data-subject rights requests.

art28_3_f_security_assistance.hypothesis: The processor assists the controller with security, personal-data-breach, and DPIA obligations.

art28_3_g_deletion_return.hypothesis: At the end of the services the processor deletes or returns personal data and existing copies.

art28_3_h_audit.hypothesis: The processor makes available information necessary to demonstrate compliance and allows audits and inspections.

art28_4_subprocessor_flow_down.hypothesis: A subprocessor is bound by the same data-protection obligations as the processor.

provenance.reason: The user focus is specifically on subprocessor requirements under GDPR Article 28. Standard seed requirements cover prior written authorization, notification of subprocessor changes/objection rights, pass-through obligations, and initial processor liability. Reading the candidate catalog descriptions: 'gdpr.art28.2' covers prior written authorization (specific/general) and change notice/objection; 'gdpr.art28.3.d' covers compliance with Art 28(2) & 28(4) including authorisation, equivalent flow-down obligations, and processor liability; and 'gdpr.art28.4' explicitly covers flow-down of equivalent obligations and initial processor liability for subprocessor performance. These three rule capabilities fully cover all four requirements.
